verdict.rationale: Kick is a SaaS accounting product, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The evidence shows no such spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The MCP server, CLI, and GitBook llms.txt/markdown mirrors are adjacent surfaces, not a downloadable API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
